products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters is a publicly traded global content and technology company, listed on both Nasdaq and the TSX under the ticker TRI, and headquartered in Toronto. The company describes itself as delivering technology with purpose, aimed at helping professionals in legal, tax, accounting, trade, risk, and government sectors make faster decisions and gain sharper insights. Its platform offerings include tools for legal research, tax and trade compliance, and risk management, with the company framing its approach around what it calls Fiduciary-Grade AI grounded in authoritative content and domain expertise.

The company's primary AI product is CoCounsel, a legal AI assistant integrated with Westlaw and Practical Law content and designed for litigation support, research, drafting, and multi-step legal workflows. Thomson Reuters describes CoCounsel as its AI of choice for professionals requiring defensible work product. A case study on its site notes that a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI to increase litigation capacity by 100 percent. The company has also launched ONESOURCE+, an AI-powered platform connecting tax, trade, legal, and risk functions. In August 2026, Thomson Reuters announced Thomson, described as the company's first proprietary large language model developed in-house, and reported that global law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP had deployed the next generation of CoCounsel Legal.

The site's held facts confirm the company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001075124, organized as a for-profit public company, and has been tracked on this site with CoCounsel listed under the Finance and Legal AI category, with noted considerations around attorney work product risk. No litigation cases or MCP server entries are recorded in the held facts.
